topic.title: Multi-Task Learning and Model Merging
topic.overview: Multi-task methods share information across objectives, either during joint training or by combining separately adapted models. This cluster studies task grouping, shared representations, asymmetric transfer, and weight-space merging. The central question is when sharing helps and when it creates interference or overemphasizes common structure.
topic.whyItMatters: Related tasks are not automatically compatible at every layer or update direction. Good combinations need to account for both conflicting knowledge and repeated contributions from already shared components.
topic.evolution: Early representatives investigate learning many tasks with backpropagation and shared model bias. Later work develops flexible task clusters and feature sharing. Recent approaches learn which task combinations work well, analyze shared linear representations, and calibrate merged spectra to avoid counting overlapping directions repeatedly.
openQuestions: Can task compatibility be predicted without training every possible combination?
How should a merged model balance shared capabilities against rare task-specific behavior?

papers.title: Mastering Massive Multi-Task Reinforcement Learning via Mixture-of-Expert Decision Transformer
papers.tldr: M3DT combines expert-based Decision Transformers with three-stage training to improve offline multi-task learning and scale to 160 tasks.

papers.title: Modeling Multi-Task Model Merging as Adaptive Projective Gradient Descent
papers.tldr: The method merges experts through data-free constrained optimization that preserves shared knowledge while reducing disagreement with task-specific models.

papers.title: MTL-UE: Learning to Learn Nothing for Multi-Task Learning
papers.tldr: MTL-UE generates perturbations that hinder multi-task model training using label information and regularized class embeddings.

papers.title: No Task Left Behind: Isotropic Model Merging with Common and Task-Specific Subspaces
papers.tldr: An isotropic merging method balances shared and task-specific weight-update components to improve multitask performance without additional training.

papers.title: Representation Surgery in Model Merging with Probabilistic Modeling
papers.tldr: ProbSurgery models representation bias probabilistically to improve corrections for interference introduced by model merging.

papers.title: Whoever Started the interference Should End It: Guiding Data-Free Model Merging via Task Vectors
papers.tldr: WUDI-Merging uses task-vector geometry to address interference when combining expert models without additional data or rescaling coefficients.

papers.title: Continual Model Merging without Data: Dual Projections for Balancing Stability and Plasticity
papers.tldr: Dual Orthogonal Projection merges sequentially arriving experts without data while balancing preservation of old capabilities and acquisition of new ones.

papers.title: Continual Optimization with Symmetry Teleportation for Multi-Task Learning
papers.tldr: COST reduces multi-task optimization conflict by moving between loss-equivalent parameter configurations and reusing optimization history.

papers.title: Exploring Tradeoffs through Mode Connectivity for Multi-Task Learning
papers.tldr: EXTRA uses flexible paths between model solutions to efficiently explore multi-task tradeoffs and find a preferred compromise.

papers.title: Fast Rate Bounds for Multi-Task and Meta-Learning with Different Sample Sizes
papers.tldr: New PAC-Bayesian bounds provide fast-rate guarantees for tasks with unequal dataset sizes and clarify alternative ways to weight task risk.

papers.title: Geometry-Aware Collaborative Multi-Solutions Optimizer for Model Fine-Tuning with Parameter Efficiency
papers.tldr: A geometry-informed optimizer develops collaborative, diverse solutions while updating few parameters, improving performance across several tested fine-tuning settings.

papers.title: MoORE: SVD-based Model MoE-ization for Conflict- and Oblivion-Resistant Multi-Task Adaptation
papers.tldr: MoORE routes among orthogonal components of pretrained weights to improve multi-task adaptation while resisting interference and forgetting.

papers.title: NTKMTL: Mitigating Task Imbalance in Multi-Task Learning from Neural Tangent Kernel Perspective
papers.tldr: NTKMTL uses Neural Tangent Kernel analysis to balance task convergence speeds, with an efficient shared-representation approximation.

papers.title: Objective Soups: Multilingual Multi-Task Modeling for Speech Processing
papers.tldr: Objective Soups studies three ways to organize conflicting multilingual speech objectives, using selected layers to keep gradient-conflict handling lightweight.

papers.title: PiKE: Adaptive Data Mixing for Large-Scale Multi-Task Learning Under Low Gradient Conflicts
papers.tldr: PiKE dynamically adjusts training-data mixtures using non-conflicting gradient interactions, improving convergence and downstream results in large-scale pretraining experiments.

papers.title: RobustMerge: Parameter-Efficient Model Merging for MLLMs with Direction Robustness
papers.tldr: RobustMerge combines parameter-efficient multimodal experts without training by stabilizing parameter directions and normalizing across tasks.

papers.title: Technical Debt in In-Context Learning: Diminishing Efficiency in Long Context
papers.tldr: In a hierarchical regression setting, in-context learning initially matches Bayesian sample efficiency but becomes less efficient as context grows.

papers.title: Towards Minimizing Feature Drift in Model Merging: Layer-wise Task Vector Fusion for Adaptive Knowledge Integration
papers.tldr: LOT Merging combines task experts by analytically minimizing layer-wise feature drift, improving benchmark performance with basic matrix operations.

papers.title: Towards Multi-Table Learning: A Novel Paradigm for Complementarity Quantification and Integration
papers.tldr: A complementarity metric and cross-table attention network provide a unified approach to measuring and combining information across tables.

papers.title: Variational Task Vector Composition
papers.tldr: VTVC uses Bayesian inference and sparse gating to compose task vectors separately for each sample.

papers.title: Adaptive Estimation and Inference in Semi-parametric Heterogeneous Clustered Multitask Learning via Neyman Orthogonality
papers.tldr: An adaptive estimator discovers shared task groups while reducing the influence of errors in task-specific nuisance estimates.

papers.title: Breaking Multi-Task Curse: Reward-Weighted Evolution for Black-Box Many-Task Optimization
papers.tldr: MES-RET uses reward-weighted evaluations and information transfer to improve black-box optimization across many weakly related tasks.

papers.title: BRIDGE: Predicting Human Task Completion Time From Model Performance
papers.tldr: BRIDGE links model-derived task difficulty to human completion time, enabling capability comparisons in terms of human task length.

papers.title: Collaborative and Efficient Fine-tuning: Leveraging Task Similarity
papers.tldr: CoLoRA combines shared and personalized low-rank adapters so similar tasks can benefit from collaborative fine-tuning.

papers.title: CORE-MTL: Rethinking Gradient Balancing via Causal Orthogonal Representations
papers.tldr: CORE-MTL separates task-relevant features from nuisance variation to reduce interference and improve visual multi-task generalization.

papers.title: Latent Space Robust Optimization of Neural Processes with Aligned Stratified Order-Statistic Loss Reduction
papers.tldr: OS-NPs balance learning across latent-particle difficulty groups, improving tail-risk robustness while maintaining or improving average performance in experiments.

papers.title: Learning to Extrapolate to New Tasks: A Relational Approach to Task Extrapolation
papers.tldr: RTE predicts unseen tasks by learning transformations that connect them to known anchor tasks.

papers.title: Multi-task Linear Regression without Eigenvalue Lower Bounds: Adaptivity, Robustness, and Safety
papers.tldr: A matrix-weighted estimator provides robust multi-task regression guarantees under weaker spectral assumptions and safeguards against harmful task sharing.

papers.title: Near-Optimal and Efficient First-Order Algorithm for Multi-Task Learning with Shared Linear Representation
papers.tldr: A first-order likelihood-based algorithm jointly learns shared linear representations and task parameters with near-optimal estimation error.

papers.title: Neural Thickets: Diverse Task Experts Are Dense Around Pretrained Weights
papers.tldr: Large, well-pretrained models contain dense nearby task experts that can be sampled, selected, and ensembled competitively with standard post-training methods.

papers.title: Post-Hoc Merging is Not Enough: Many-Shot Model Merging with Loss-Gap Balancing
papers.tldr: METIS uses repeated, loss-aware model merging to mitigate task interference and substantially improve the weakest task.

papers.title: Revisiting the Role of Pretrained Weights in Model Merging: On Near-Optimality within the Core Subspace
papers.tldr: Preserving a core subspace of pretrained weights while merging adaptations into complementary directions improves training-free model merging.

papers.title: SyMerge: From Non-Interference to Synergistic Merging via Single-Layer Adaptation
papers.tldr: SyMerge jointly adjusts merging coefficients and one task-specific layer to enable task synergy, including for models with different initializations.

papers.title: When More Data Doesn’t Help: Limits of Adaptation in Multitask Learning
papers.tldr: A stronger impossibility result shows that arbitrarily large datasets per task do not by themselves guarantee optimal multitask adaptation.

papers.title: When Shared Knowledge Hurts: Spectral Over-Accumulation in Model Merging
papers.tldr: Singular Value Calibration improves model merging by correcting the excessive accumulation of spectral directions shared across task updates.
